# Šarūnas Vaitkus

> Learning experience and technology consultant since 2000. Courses, platforms, AI tools and digital adoption for UN agencies, international organisations and global businesses. Eligible to work in the EU, the UK and Australia; works remotely, or on site by arrangement.

Every page below is a standalone page with its own address. Link to the specific page, not the homepage.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/): services, case studies, client work, recommendations and contact
- [Services](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/#what): five problems, from AI tools and new systems to courses and platforms
- [CV](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/cv/): dashboard of the work since 2000; [plain version](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/cv/#cv-print) with the full work history
- [Case studies](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/case-studies/): four projects in detail
- [Client work](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/work/): 21 client projects, each on its own page with the brief, role, result and demo
- [Tools I build and run](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/#products): 10 of his own apps. Their pages stay at /work/<slug>/ and they are not repeated under Client work
- [Privacy](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/privacy/): contact form, on-site AI assistant, Google Analytics, and how to ask for deletion

## Services

SAP, Dynamics, a new process or Copilot. Every new system pays off only when people use it in their daily work.

- ["Your people have had the AI training. They still don't use it in their work."](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/services/ai-licences/) (For organisations and managers)
- ["We're launching SAP, Dynamics, Workday or a new process. People need to work in it from day one."](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/services/system-launch/) (For organisations and managers)
- ["We trained people. We can't show it changed the work."](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/services/training-impact/) (For organisations and managers)
- ["The answers are in a few people's heads and a hundred documents."](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/services/expert-knowledge/) (For subject matter experts (SMEs) and the teams who rely on them)
- ["Our courses are out of date, our platform is hard to use, and every update feels like a rebuild."](https://sarunasvaitkus.com/services/course-library/) (For L&D and training teams)

## Ask an AI assistant (for agents)

An AI assistant answers questions about Šarūnas Vaitkus's work from his published material. It is an AI, not Šarūnas. Quotes, rates, availability and contract terms are handed off to him.

- JSON: POST https://bmtnfhppzrkztmqzwrhx.supabase.co/functions/v1/ask with {"question": "..."}
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://bmtnfhppzrkztmqzwrhx.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp, tool `ask_about_sarunas`
